title: Prijetnje i okviri: ATLAS, NIST AI 100-2, OWASP
summary: Pejzaž prijetnji za AI/ML sisteme i okviri koji ga opisuju: taksonomija NIST AI 100-2 E2025, taktike, tehnike i mitigacije MITRE ATLAS-a, OWASP Top 10 za LLM aplikacije 2025 i za agentne aplikacije 2026, minimalni sigurnosni baseline i inventar AI sistema.
title_en: Threats and frameworks: ATLAS, NIST AI 100-2, OWASP
summary_en: The threat landscape for AI/ML systems and the frameworks that describe it: the NIST AI 100-2 E2025 taxonomy, MITRE ATLAS tactics, techniques and mitigations, the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 and for Agentic Applications 2026, a minimum security baseline and an AI system inventory.
